newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine H1 inflation up to 6 pct-minister.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine H1 inflation up to 6 pct-minister.

text.p: Ukraine's inflation in the first half of 1997 will be no higher than six percent, Economy Minister Yuri Yekhanurov said on Friday.
"We forecast inflation at no more than six percent for the first half of this year," he told an investment conference.
Yekhanurov did not state inflation figures in the first half of 1996. The 1997 draft budget forecasts annual inflation at 24.8 percent compared to 39.7 percent last year.
The Economy Minister said a government decision to delay charging 100 percent versus 80 percent for living quarters and communal services was one reason for slowed inflation.
Another was that Ukraine owed 5 billion hryvnias to its workers, he added.
A presidential adviser said last week June inflation would not exceed May or April inflation of 0.8 percent, and said annual inflation would be 13-14 percent.
